summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for July 2026, attaching as Exhibit 99.1 an Amended and Restated Share Compensation Plan. The filing is a routine administrative update to the company's equity incentive plan, detailing definitions, eligibility, and mechanics for restricted share unit awards. It does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or sudden management change. This is a standard compensation plan amendment with no special-situation catalyst.
